record.question: Who won the 2019 Australian Open Mens Single title?
record.explanation: Answer C: Novak Djokovic. Novak Djokovic won the 2019 Australian Open men’s singles final against Rafael Nadal 6–3, 6–2, 6–3. The tournament’s original AO 2019 review records his seventh title and the final result. Historical/source note: 2019 men’s singles title; later editions and career totals are irrelevant. Reference: https://ausopen.com/articles/features/big-numbers-ao2019. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
